name: karakeep
title: Karakeep
description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
author: luolei

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Language used for the extension's own interface. Your bookmarks are unaffected.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: Where your Karakeep instance is reachable, including the port

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Create one in Karakeep under Settings → API Keys

preferences.name: linkMainAction
preferences.label: Opening a Bookmark
preferences.title: Opening a Bookmark
preferences.description: What ↵ does on a URL bookmark

preferences.name: prefillUrlFromBrowser
preferences.label: Use the Current Browser Tab
preferences.title: Creating Bookmarks
preferences.description: Fill in the URL from your frontmost tab when creating a bookmark. Uses the Raycast browser extension when available, and falls back to AppleScript on macOS.

preferences.label: Website Icons
preferences.name: showWebsitePreview
preferences.title: Bookmark List
preferences.description: Show each site's favicon in place of a generic icon

preferences.name: displayBookmarkPreview
preferences.label: Preview Images
preferences.description: Show a thumbnail of the page. Each one is fetched and cached, so this can slow a large library.

preferences.name: displayTags
preferences.label: Tags
preferences.description: Show the tags attached to each bookmark

preferences.name: displayCreatedAt
preferences.label: Date Saved
preferences.description: Show when the bookmark was added

preferences.name: displayDescription
preferences.label: Description
preferences.description: Show the page description beneath the title

preferences.name: displayNote
preferences.label: Notes
preferences.description: Show any note you have attached to the bookmark

preferences.name: displayBookmarkStatus
preferences.label: Favorite and Archive Status
preferences.description: Mark bookmarks that are favorited or archived

preferences.name: displaySummary
preferences.label: AI Summary
preferences.description: Show Karakeep's generated summary when one exists

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Troubleshooting
preferences.label: Verbose Logging
preferences.description: Write detailed request and error logs to the Raycast console

commands.name: backups
commands.title: Backups
commands.subtitle: Karakeep
commands.description: Create, download, and delete account backups

commands.name: quickBookmark
commands.title: Quick Bookmark
commands.subtitle: Karakeep
commands.description: Quickly bookmark the current browser tab

commands.name: updateKarakeep
commands.title: Update Karakeep
commands.description: Pull the latest Docker images and restart a local Karakeep instance

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
